purpose: Complete the mid-level layer so the redefined secondary has a candidate in every dimension it can activate.

reasoning_that_changes_the_original_prop.finding: The 11 equivalence classes are 9 single-dimension classes plus 2 cross-dimension ones: dark_chocolate on nutty_cocoa+roasted, and lemongrass on fruity+green_vegetative.
reasoning_that_changes_the_original_prop.consequence: A completed broad.* layer is literally the naming of the equivalence classes the topology supports. The mid-level layer is not an addition to the structure; it is the structure made expressible.

reasoning_that_changes_the_original_prop.finding: The taste dimension has exactly one member, sensory.bitter.
reasoning_that_changes_the_original_prop.consequence: A representative for taste would say 'taste-family' where the system could already say 'bitter'. That is a LOSS of specificity, not a gain.
reasoning_that_changes_the_original_prop.decision: Do not author a representative for taste. The ask drops from 7 concepts to 6.

reasoning_that_changes_the_original_prop.finding: A new broad.* concept has a feature vector identical to its dimension siblings, so it joins the equivalence class rather than splitting it.
reasoning_that_changes_the_original_prop.consequence: This change will NOT improve max_class_size, equivalence_class_count or per-column variance, and must not be measured by the representation-progress rule the owner just set. It is an expressibility change, not a representation change. Measuring it by that rule would report failure for a change that is working as intended.
reasoning_that_changes_the_original_prop.correct_metric: secondary non-empty rate, and mean secondary count per record.

not_proposed.reason: single member, sensory.bitter; a representative would reduce specificity

naming_collision_check.method: Compared each proposed short name against every existing member short name in its dimension.
naming_collision_check.note: broad.green is chosen over broad.vegetal to avoid confusion with the existing green_tea member.

deterministic_selection_rule_required.problem: nutty_cocoa carries two representatives, broad.chocolate and broad.nutty. The prototype's middle_candidates[0] resolves this by registry insertion order, which is incidental rather than declared.
deterministic_selection_rule_required.proposed_rule: Lexicographic on concept id. For nutty_cocoa this yields broad.chocolate.
deterministic_selection_rule_required.status: PROPOSED, requires owner confirmation because it is a product-facing wording choice, not a technical detail.
deterministic_selection_rule_required.alternative_worth_considering: Prefer the representative whose members carry the most direct evidence in the current corpus. Rejected here as it makes the output depend on corpus composition rather than on a declared rule.

projected_effect.caveat: 0.77 assumes each direct named descriptor covers a distinct dimension. In practice they cluster, since 23 of 59 descriptors sit in fruity alone, so real uncovered count is higher.
projected_effect.estimated_secondary_fill: roughly 1 to 1.5 per record, against 0 today
projected_effect.measurement_blocked: Exact fill requires the 474 per-case returns in owner-controlled storage. This is a bound, not a measurement.

does: Removes the structural emptiness of secondary for 8 of 9 dimensions
Lets the system say 'floral-family' where it currently says nothing
Preserves OUT_SEPARATED: all six concepts carry role NAMED_DESCRIPTOR
does_not: Enable within-class discrimination. main stays direct-evidence only at mean 1.92.
Create relation edges. The 312 occurrences requiring an edge still require one.
Change what the system knows. It changes what it can say about what it knows.
